name: devtools
description: Opt-in runtime devtools overlay for AppKit apps with prompt generation and localhost bridge forwarding

enabledByDefault.description: Render the devtools by default without requiring ?inspect=1.

bridgeTarget.description: Localhost bridge endpoint that receives POST /context payloads.

maxForwardPayloadBytes.description: Maximum serialized payload size forwarded to the local bridge.

maxRecentEvents.description: Maximum recent client and server events included in generated bundles.

maxStoredSessions.description: Maximum number of devtools sessions stored in memory.

maxStoredEventsPerSession.description: Maximum number of recent request events retained per session.
